messages:
maria: Heads-up — Sales needs a quick risk check for CloudStore integration POC. They uploaded a CAIQ and a redacted SOC cover note. Data plane access + SSO in scope. Who can own the vendor review?

devon: I can take initial triage. Do we have a contact or portal link? :eyes:

maria: Link in the RFQ: https://vendor.cloudstore.io/security — contact is emily@cloudstore. Sales says customer wants answers back in 3 business days.

devon: OK I'll pull the CAIQ and map answers to our vendor matrix. Quick flag: they answered encryption at rest but no KMS vendor listed. ETA EOD today.

samir: Need subprocessors list + data flow diagram too. If they're asking for VPC peering, we must validate network isolation and egress controls. Also confirm whether keys are BYOK.

devon: Pulled CAIQ. Example snippet:
``
Q: How is data encrypted at rest?
A: Data is encrypted using AES-256.
```
They don't state KMS or key ownership. I'll request clarifications and evidence (KMS ARN, config, or attestation).

sec-bot: Vendor risk score set to 'moderate' pending KMS and SOC2 Type II report. Automated check: missing subprocessors list and pen-test summary. Tagging @ciso for visibility.

sales-bot: Reminder: customer deadline in 3 business days — sales needs substantive answers or a mitigation plan.

maria: Can we ask for: (1) redacted SOC2 Type II report, (2) KMS/Encryption architecture + key ownership statement, (3) full subprocessors list, (4) pen test summary, (5) SAML/SCIM integration docs and SSO configuration guidance? @devon can you send the ask and include SLA & incident response contacts.

devon: Drafting email now. Will send to emily@cloudstore and paste thread copy. Draft message:
``
Hi Emily,
Can you provide the following to support Redwood's vendor risk review: 
1) Redacted SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months)
2) Encryption architecture details and whether KMS is customer-controlled (BYOK) or vendor-managed (include vendor, ARNs, or screenshots)
3) Up-to-date subprocessors list with data processing locations
4) Penetration test summary and remediation timeline for any open findings
5) SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning docs and support contact
6) SLA and incident response contact + any history of security incidents in the past 3 years
Thanks,
Devon
```

samir: Also ask for their SSP (system security plan) and any third-party attestations (ISO, PCI) they claim. If they refuse or delay, we'll escalate to procurement and sales to decide a compensating control (e.g., restricted scope, no data ingestion).

maria: Sounds good. Keep updates here. If they can't produce evidence by EOD Tue we'll mark 'escalate' and loop in legal/procurement.

devon: Sent the email at 1765123480 — pasted copy and link to vendor portal. Will update when we get replies.

sec-bot: Noted. I'll auto-add checklist items to the ticket: SOC2, KMS proof, subprocessors, pen-test, SSP.

ciso: Thanks for the heads-up. If encryption is vendor-managed without BYOK, that's a potential blocker for enterprise customers — prepare mitigation options.

maria: Thanks team — please keep replies short and paste any vendor artifacts here (redacted).
